title.en: Google open-sources TensorFlow — deep learning becomes accessible
title.zhHans: Google 开源 TensorFlow——深度学习走向普及

searchSummary.en: TensorFlow (2015): Google open-sourced the deep learning framework that became the industry standard. How open-sourcing AI infrastructure accelerated research and adoption worldwide.
searchSummary.zhHans: TensorFlow（2015）：Google 开源了深度学习框架，它成为行业标准。开源 AI 基础设施如何加速了全球的研究和应用。

summary.en: Google releases TensorFlow as an open-source deep learning framework under Apache 2.0 license. It quickly becomes the most widely adopted machine learning library, powering research and production systems across industries.
summary.zhHans: Google 以 Apache 2.0 协议开源 TensorFlow 深度学习框架。它迅速成为最广泛采用的机器学习库，支撑了各行业的研究与生产系统。

narrative.en:
Before TensorFlow, deep learning frameworks were either proprietary (Google's DistBelief, Facebook's early internal tools) or academic projects (Caffe, Theano) with limited production readiness. Researchers shared code through PDFs and ad-hoc scripts.

TensorFlow changed this by combining Google's production-scale engineering with an open, flexible architecture. Its computational graph model, automatic differentiation, Python API, and visualization tool TensorBoard made deep learning accessible to anyone with a laptop. Within a week of launch, it gained over 11,000 GitHub stars.

TensorFlow's open-source release was a pivotal moment: it democratized access to state-of-the-art deep learning tools, accelerated research by enabling reproducible experiments, and established open-source AI infrastructure as the industry norm.
narrative.zhHans:
在 TensorFlow 之前，深度学习框架要么是闭源的（Google 的 DistBelief、Facebook 的内部工具），要么是学术项目（Caffe、Theano），不足以支撑生产环境。研究者通过 PDF 和临时脚本分享代码。

TensorFlow 改变了这一切：它将 Google 的生产级工程能力与开放的灵活架构结合在一起。计算图模型、自动微分、Python API 和可视化工具 TensorBoard 让任何人只要有台笔记本就能做深度学习。上线一周内获得超过 11,000 个 GitHub Star。

TensorFlow 的开源发布是一个转折点：它将最先进的深度学习工具民主化，通过可复现实验加速了研究，并确立了开源 AI 基础设施的行业标准。

description.en: TensorFlow made deep learning tools accessible to anyone, from students to startups to enterprise teams.
description.zhHans: TensorFlow 让任何人都能使用深度学习工具——从学生到初创公司再到企业团队。

description.en: Enabled reproducible deep learning research and scalable production deployments across industries.
description.zhHans: 使深度学习研究可复现，并支撑各行业的大规模生产部署。

description.en: Open-source AI infrastructure lowered barriers to entry, accelerating the AI startup ecosystem.
description.zhHans: 开源 AI 基础设施降低了进入门槛，加速了 AI 创业生态。

text.en: TensorFlow was released as open source on November 9, 2015 under Apache 2.0 license.
text.zhHans: TensorFlow 于 2015 年 11 月 9 日以 Apache 2.0 协议开源发布。

text.en: TensorFlow gained over 11,000 GitHub stars in its first week after launch.
text.zhHans: TensorFlow 上线第一周获得超过 11,000 个 GitHub Star。
